comparator.name: Arts and Culture Studies
comparator.sourceNotes: Current official OER Article5 pp7–9 and Article10 p13 control the supported facts. B1 comprises nine credit-bearing units totalling60EC, plus0EC mentoring/PPO and RADAr. B2 and B3 bear different explicit cohort labels. The first-year prerequisites for current Spatial/Visual Culture are Cultural Theory and Analyse van Beeld respectively; the thesis requires all compulsory B2 major courses. Article7 and the Working in the Cultural Field footnote impose different replacement/internship outcomes if the older LET-ACWB708 was already passed. The 2025 annual regulations show a materially different B2/B3 structure. The faculty index states that only the current OER governs post2016 entrants, so an old degree table is not an alternative current rule. The archive-labelled2024 link has extracted2024 text but a visibly2025 cover/table; it cannot supply verified2024 entrant requirements. Nomissing credits are invented and no later cohort rows are joined into the active first-year subset.

routeSelection.basis: The normalized target itself names Algemene Cultuurwetenschappen. The 2026-2027 OER distinguishes it from the Arts and Culture Studies and Society, Language and Culture specialisations, so the exact Dutch ACW route is reconstructed.

programmes.label: Arts and Culture Studies at Radboud University

exception.reason: Provide an authoritative complete 180-EC pathway for one identified current Algemene Cultuurwetenschappen entrant cohort, including the controlling later-year major, minor/free-space and Working in the Cultural Field rules. The 2026–2027 OER lists B1 for new entrants, B2 explicitly for cohort 2025–2026 and B3 explicitly for cohort 2024–2025. The 2025–2026 OER instead has a 45-EC B2 major plus 15-EC choice and a 40-EC B3 minor, whereas current B2 uses 30-EC major plus 30-EC minors and current B3 uses 30-EC major/thesis plus 30-EC free space. Current prospective pages describe indicative 2027–2030 years and a different B3 music component. Clarify the applicable cohort and transition; a cross-cohort 60+60+60 sum cannot establish one valid pathway.

audience.programmeDescription: The Dutch-taught Algemene Cultuurwetenschappen route studies visual art, literature, music, film, television and performance through historical, theoretical and social perspectives. Students develop cultural criticism, research and cultural-sector practice.
audience.comparisonExplanation: The external curriculum is under review because the published year tables apply to different entrant cohorts. A complete UCR comparison is withheld until one coherent degree pathway is confirmed.

curriculum.limitation: Only the 60-EC first-year curriculum for 2026 entrants is shown. Later-year tables refer to earlier cohorts and cannot yet certify this cohort’s complete degree.

componentNotes.acw-y1-skills: The separate mentoring/PPO and RADAr academic-language requirements carry 0 EC; they are not added to the 60-EC credit total.
